approved_scope.title: The leak check flags an scp-style host path as the host name and the path it carries (#275)
approved_scope.description: The leak check flags an scp-style host path as the host name and the path it carries (#275)
acceptance_criteria: A committed value holding an scp-style remote path <host>:/<absolute path> is refused as a path leak when a home or system root follows the colon, and its host part is refused as a host-name leak when it is the local host, in the write guard, --redact and doctor's scan alike.

answers.constraints: REQ-records-006 leak rules; the 0.6.1 short-host-name lesson (an ordinary word equal to a short host name is not a leak)
